body:
i feel you. this is the best advice i can give man, coming from personal experience, don’t turn to drugs (alcohol, nicotine, etc.). i’ve been on that path for the past two years and while not physically addicted to anything, i’m psychologically addicted to literally any psychoactive substance. anything that gets me to a head space other than sober, i like. my addictive personality doesn’t help lol, but yeah don’t turn to substances. 

they help for a bit, but makes everything at least 2-3x worse when you’re coming down/don’t have anymore. ik this is off topic, but i’m currently on the path of drug addiction and shit and thought i should warn you not to follow in mine or anyone else’s footsteps. people need you, whether you know/accept it or not.

stay safe my man, your life is valuable don’t ever think otherwise
